description: Service Industries Limited's stated principal activities are the purchase, manufacture and sale of footwear, tyres and tubes and technical rubber products, and its group describes itself as the largest manufacturer of footwear, tyres and tubes in Pakistan. Footwear is made at factories in Gujrat and Muridke, while the tyre range covers motorcycle, bicycle and other applications. In 2019 the group entered a strategic joint venture with Chaoyang Long March Tyre Co. Ltd. that established Pakistan's first dedicated radial truck and bus tyre plant.
headOffice: Servis House, 2-Main Gulberg, Jail Road, Lahore 54662, Pakistan
